appearance_facts.fact: Title: 'Incidence of Condition A in US States'.
Map of the United States with states colored by incidence level of Condition A.
Color scale legend on the right: 'Low' (dark red) to 'High' (light yellow), with labeled tick values: 0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100.
States are labeled with two-letter postal abbreviations (e.g., WA, TX, CO).
States with the highest incidence (darkest red) include: Washington (WA), Minnesota (MN), Iowa (IA), Nebraska (NE), Oklahoma (OK), Georgia (GA), Florida (FL), Kentucky (KY), and New York (NY).
Texas (TX) is colored light yellow, indicating the lowest incidence among the three options.
Colorado (CO) is colored dark red, indicating high incidence.
Washington (WA) is colored dark red, indicating high incidence.
